title: conyza boranensis
intro: Conyza boranensis, commonly known as Ethiopian fleabane, is a plant species in the daisy family, Asteraceae. The health benefits of Conyza boranensis include its potential use as an anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial agent, which may help in managing conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including essential oils and flavonoids, which have been shown to possess antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. Bioactive constituents of Conyza boranensis include flavonoids, saponins, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
